Inside the spa

Representative spa photography used for this concept page.

A family-owned Lake View spa

Elite Chicago Spa is a family-owned medical spa at 3952 N Southport Ave in Lake View, Chicago. Its focus is high-ticket, non-surgical care — body sculpting first, with RF microneedling, injectables and laser treatments alongside facials — rather than discount or coupon-led offers.

How booking works

1

Request a consultation

Use the form below or call (312) 841-9750.

2

Get a clear plan

Your provider confirms the treatment, timing and price — including CoolSculpting area pricing above.

3

Book your treatment

Book only after you know the plan. CoolSculpting sessions are spaced 8–10 weeks apart.
